briefdescription.para: getPassName - Return a nice clean name for a pass.

detaileddescription.para: This usually implemented in terms of the name that is registered by one of the Registration templates, but can be overloaded directly.

briefdescription.para: getAnalysisUsage - This function should be overriden by passes that need analysis information to do their job.

detaileddescription.para: If a pass specifies that it uses a particular analysis result to this function, it can then use the getAnalysis<AnalysisType>() function, below.

briefdescription.para: runOnMachineFunction - This method must be overloaded to perform the desired machine code transformation or analysis.
